title: Smart Attendance Management System
problem: Colleges track student attendance manually on paper, which is slow, error-prone, and makes it hard to flag students who are falling below the required attendance threshold.
solution: A Spring Boot web application backed by a MySQL database that exposes REST APIs for faculty to mark attendance and for students to view their attendance percentage, plus a model that predicts which students are at risk of a shortage.
contribution: I built the Java Spring Boot backend, designed the MySQL database schema, implemented the REST APIs for marking and querying attendance, and built the machine-learning model that predicts which students are at risk of falling below the attendance threshold.
claims: Built the Java Spring Boot backend
Implemented REST APIs for marking and querying attendance
Built a machine-learning model that predicts students at risk of low attendance
